name: meta-mcp
description: Meta Ads (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, update_budget, pause_resume. Every tool maps to a

platform_mcp_meta_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_META_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_meta_access_token.description: Long-lived user or Business Manager system-user access token with ads_read (reads) and ads_management (budget updates), from an app with the Marketing API product; sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v26.0/me?fields=id,name: the user (or system user) behind the token.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /me/adaccounts. `id` is the `act_<ad_account_id>` form that the other tools take as account_id; account_status 1 = ACTIVE, 2 = DISABLED, 101 = CLOSED. Up to 100 accounts (list_accounts takes no paging arguments); paging is cursor-based (paging.cursors.after), so only the first page is returned.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /act_<id>/campaigns (account_id must carry the act_ prefix, as list_accounts returns it). By default only non-archived, non-deleted campaigns. `status` is not sent (the effective_status filter is a JSON list). daily_budget/lifetime_budget in raw are strings in the currency's minor unit (cents), so they are not mapped to `budget`. Paging is cursor-based; only the first page is returned.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: POST /{campaign_id} {daily_budget} answers {success: true}. daily_budget is an integer in the account currency's MINOR unit (e.g. 5000 = 50.00 USD) and applies only to campaigns using campaign budget (Advantage+ campaign budget); ad-set budgets are set on the ad set. `currency` is ignored (the account currency applies).

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: POST /{campaign_id} {status: PAUSED|ACTIVE} (pause → PAUSED, resume → ACTIVE) answers {success: true}. Pausing a campaign stops all its ad sets and ads; ARCHIVED/DELETED are not reachable from this verb.
